entries.name: Zorua
entries.label: Lure Encounters — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: From 2:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. local time , Zorua will have a very high chance of appearing at PokeStops with active regular Lure Modules.

entries.name: Zorua
entries.label: Lure Encounters — Saturday — Shiny
entries.source_text: Zorua attracted to regular Lure Modules will still have an increased chance to be Shiny and may have a Special Background. That's more chances to encounter the featured Pokemon even after the event hours!

entries.name: Zorua
entries.label: Raids — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: Take a few snapshots during Community Day for a surprise! During the event you can snap an AR Photo and get photobombed by Zorua.

entries.name: Zorua
entries.label: Field Research — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: October Community Day—themed Field Research will be available! Catch Zorua to earn rewards such as Stardust, Ultra Balls, additional encounters with Zorua, and more! You may even find Field Research that leads to encounters with Zorua that have a Special Background—if you're lucky!

entries.name: Zorua
entries.label: Timed Research — Saturday — Normal
entries.source_text: Check in at a Community Ambassador event to receive Timed Research with Zorua encounters featuring a Special Background and other premium item rewards. Find a nearby meetup on the Pokemon GO event map .

entries.source_text: Shiny Zorua will be available! Trainers will have an increased chance of encountering Shiny Zorua during Community Day.
